info.title: SutraERP API
info.description:
SutraERP education ERP — synchronous REST/JSON API (major version v1).

Conventions (ADR-L5-0034): camelCase JSON members; URL major versioning (`/api/v1`); RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` errors with `errorCode`, `correlationId` and `validationErrors` extensions; retry-sensitive commands accept `Idempotency-Key`.

Authentication (ADR-L5-0024/0038): dev mode signs in with `POST /api/v1/auth/login` (+ TOTP `POST /api/v1/auth/mfa/verify`); Keycloak mode with the OIDC Authorization Code + PKCE flow `GET /api/v1/auth/oidc/start` → `/oidc/callback`. Both set an opaque `HttpOnly` session cookie; the session's `csrfToken` must be sent as `X-CSRF-Token` on every POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE made with the cookie. Login and MFA verification instead need the signed double-submit token from `GET /api/v1/auth/csrf`. Unsafe requests from another site (`Origin` / `Sec-Fetch-Site`) are rejected. Tenant/institution scope is taken from the session (ADR-L5-0004); scope headers cannot select or widen it. Admin-sensitive permissions need an MFA-verified session (`mfa-step-up-required`). Missing session: 401; CSRF failure, cross-site request, missing permission or step-up: 403 (`application/problem+json`).

get.summary: Issue a pre-session (login) CSRF token.
get.description:
Sets the `__Host-sutra_login_csrf` cookie and returns the same signed value; `POST /login`
and `POST /mfa/verify` must echo it in `X-CSRF-Token` (signed double submit).

post.summary: Authenticate with login id + password (dev mode).
post.description:
Requires the pre-session CSRF token (`GET /api/v1/auth/csrf`) in `X-CSRF-Token`. On success
sets an opaque `HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict` session cookie and returns the session's
CSRF token. Principals that need MFA and have an enrolled TOTP factor get `mfaRequired` and
must call `/api/v1/auth/mfa/verify`; those without a factor get a single-factor session with
`mfaEnrollmentRequired = true`. Any presented session is revoked and replaced (fixation
defence). In Keycloak mode this endpoint answers `501` (no ROPC; use OIDC).

403.description: Login CSRF token missing/invalid or cross-site request

post.summary: End the current session (idempotent).
post.description:
With a live session the request must carry `X-CSRF-Token` (prevents forced sign-out). For a
Keycloak session the response is `200` with the IdP's RP-initiated logout URL.

200.description: Signed out; continue at the IdP to end the SSO session

403.description: CSRF token missing or invalid

get.summary: Second-factor status of the signed-in account.

post.summary: Step up the current session with a TOTP code (needed for admin-sensitive permissions).
post.description:
The session is rotated (new cookie and CSRF token) to `mfaLevel = mfa`; its absolute expiry
is unchanged. In Keycloak mode use `GET /api/v1/auth/oidc/start?stepUp=true` instead.

401.description: No session, wrong or replayed code

delete.summary: Turn off the authenticator app (needs an MFA-verified session).
delete.description: Refused (`409`) when it is the last second factor of an account whose role requires MFA.

403.description: Step-up required

404.description: No authenticator enrolled

409.description: Last factor of an account that requires MFA

post.summary: Confirm TOTP enrolment with the first code; activates the factor and upgrades the session.
post.description: The session is rotated (new cookie and CSRF token) to `mfaLevel = mfa`.

409.description: No enrolment in progress

post.summary: Start TOTP enrolment for the signed-in account (dev mode).
post.description:
Returns a fresh secret as an `otpauth://` URI; nothing changes until `…/totp/confirm`
accepts a code from it. Replacing an already active factor requires an MFA-verified session.

403.description: Replacing a factor needs step-up

post.summary: Complete a TOTP challenge issued by `login`.
post.description:
Requires the same pre-session CSRF token the challenge was issued to. A challenge is single
use (a wrong code burns it) and expires after 5 minutes; each TOTP time step is accepted once.

401.description: Unknown/expired challenge, wrong or replayed code

403.description: Login CSRF token missing/invalid

post.summary: Begin a passkey assertion to step up the current session.

409.description: No passkey registered

post.summary: Start the passkey option of a sign-in challenge.
post.description:
Consumes `challengeId` and returns a **new** one (carrying the WebAuthn ceremony) together
with the assertion options for `navigator.credentials.get`. The new id also still accepts a
TOTP code at `/api/v1/auth/mfa/verify`. Requires the pre-session CSRF token the challenge
was issued to.

409.description: No passkey registered

delete.summary:
Remove one of the caller's passkeys (needs an MFA-verified session). Removing the last
second factor of an account whose role requires MFA is refused (`409`).

403.description: Step-up required

409.description: Last factor of an account that requires MFA

post.summary: Begin registering a passkey for the signed-in account.
post.description:
Returns the creation options for `navigator.credentials.create` and a `ceremonyId`.
Adding a passkey to an account that already has a second factor needs an MFA-verified
session (`403 mfa-step-up-required`).

403.description: Step-up required

409.description: Too many passkeys

post.summary: Finish passkey registration; the session is rotated to `mfaLevel = mfa`.

409.description: Authenticator already registered

post.summary: Finish a passkey step-up; the session is rotated to `mfaLevel = mfa` (absolute expiry kept).
Finish a sign-in challenge with a passkey.
post.description:
Single use like the TOTP path: a failed assertion burns the challenge. On success the
session is created with `mfaLevel = mfa` (`amr` = `pwd`, `hwk`, `mfa`).

401.description: Unknown challenge, wrong browser, or assertion rejected

post.summary: OIDC Back-Channel Logout 1.0 receiver (Keycloak → SutraERP, server to server).
post.description:
Body: `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` with `logout_token`. The token is validated
(JWKS signature, `iss`, `aud`, `iat`/`exp`, back-channel-logout `events`, `sid`/`sub`, no
`nonce`), its `jti` must not have been seen before, and then every SutraERP session bound
to the IdP session `sid` (or, without `sid`, every federated session of `sub`) is revoked.
Answers `200` (also when no session matched) or `400`; never sets cookies.

200.description: Logout token accepted; matching sessions revoked

400.description: Missing, invalid or replayed logout token

get.summary: OIDC redirect endpoint (Keycloak → SutraERP).
get.description:
Consumes the single-use `state`, checks the browser-binding cookie, exchanges the code with
the PKCE verifier, validates the ID token (JWKS signature, `iss`, `aud`, `exp`, `nonce`),
maps roles and tenant claims, creates the session and redirects (`303`) into the SPA. Any
failure redirects to `/sign-in?authError=<code>` without a session.

get.summary: Start an OIDC sign-in at Keycloak (Authorization Code + PKCE, Keycloak mode).
get.description:
Stores `state`, `nonce` and the PKCE verifier server-side for 10 minutes, binds the request
to this browser with a `SameSite=Lax` cookie and redirects (`303`) to Keycloak.

parameters.name: returnTo
parameters.description: SPA path to land on after sign-in (relative, same origin). Defaults to `/`.

303.description: Redirect to the Keycloak authorization endpoint

get.description: Counts as activity (slides the idle window; the write is throttled).

AcademicCalendarId.description: Academic calendar (the version series for one academic cycle family).

the closure evidence evaluated.

ActivationDecision.description: Outcome chosen by the Institution Activation Authority.

Calendar.description: Academic calendar: the stable identity of a calendar series (versions live under it).

governing.description: `effective` and today (institution timezone) inside the effective period.

CalendarAssignmentId.description: Assignment of a calendar version to a governing scope (institution / campus / unit / programme).

calendarVersionId.description: The immutable base version this deviation applies to (never rewritten).

endsOn.description: Expiry (inclusive): the deviation stops governing after this business date.

governing.description: `in_effect` and today (institution timezone) inside the period.

CalendarExceptionId.description: Approved temporary deviation from a calendar (closure, rescheduled day, …).

CalendarResolution.description: Which calendar governs a scope on a business date.

exceptions.description: Exceptions of that calendar in effect on that date for the scope or the institution.

on.description: Business date resolved (defaults to today in the institution timezone).

oneOf.description: The scope the governing assignment was found on (fallback to the institution).

CalendarSimulation.description: A recorded change simulation: point-in-time baseline + proposal + impact report.

CalendarVersion.description: One calendar version (Draft → Published → Superseded / Retired) with its terms and key dates.

timezone.description:
IANA zone the dates are expressed in: the snapshot taken at publication, or the current
institution business timezone while the version is a draft.

Campus.description:
An institutional campus (B03). Physical facts (buildings, spaces, authoritative capacity)
are Domain G's and are not part of this resource.

declaredCapacity.description:
Capacity declared at registration (informational; authoritative physical capacity is
owned by Domain G and never changed by a campus modification).

pendingAction.description: Governed decision awaiting a decision-maker (`activation` / `decommission`), if any.

timezone.description: IANA zone overriding the institution's business timezone for this campus.

CampusId.description: Institutional campus (physical/operational site owned by Domain B).

CampusRevision.description: One entry of a campus' change history.

snapshot.description: The campus as it was after this change.

CampusType.description: Institutional classification of a campus (L2-B03 §23 "Campus Type").

inApp.description: Show in the in-app inbox (security notifications cannot be muted).

ChangePosition.description:
`POST …/positions/{id}/changes`: an effective-dated successor revision of an active
definition (absent members carry over from the latest revision).

effectiveFrom.description: Not before today (institution timezone) and after the latest revision's date.

critical.description:
A failing critical check makes the instance unready (503); a failing non-critical check
(advisory cache, event broker behind the outbox) only reports `degraded`.

earlyClosureReason.description: Governed exception permitting closure before the year's end date (recorded as evidence).

prepareSuccessor.description: `false` = close without preparing a next-cycle foundation.

oneOf.description:
Next-cycle foundation (planned year + draft version). Defaults: next label
(`2026-27` → `2027-28`), the day after this year ends, same length.

owner.description: Owning domain of the evidence (Academic Calendar evaluates, never modifies it).

CommandBody.description: Optional body of a state command (`{ "reason": "…" }`).

ComponentCategory.description: NEP 2020 course categories of a slot.

CreatePolicy.description: `POST …/institutions/{id}/policies`: the policy and its first draft revision.

csrfToken.description:
Pre-session CSRF token; echo it as `X-CSRF-Token` on login and MFA verification. The
same value is set in the `__Host-sutra_login_csrf` cookie (double submit).

oneOf.description: The currently published version, if any.

provenance.description: Where the evidence came from (`baseline`, `proposal`, or the owning domain).

timezone.description: IANA timezone governing business-local dates for this institution.

verified by SutraERP in dev mode, or Keycloak-asserted `amr`/`acr` values in Keycloak mode.

mfaRequired.description: The account's role requires a second factor.

webauthnAvailable.description: Dev-mode WebAuthn is available in this deployment.
